hooks.name: Run fixture letters on prompt save
hooks.description: When a file in prompts/ is saved, convert the 5 fixture letters through the full pipeline and run all 10 checks, so a prompt change that breaks a rule shows up at once. Uses live model quota on every save (about 35,000 to 105,000 tokens per run; Groq first, then OpenRouter and Gemini in development). Needs the checker service at CHECKER_URL. Takes a few minutes (15 s pause between letters).
